entries.reason: Reviewed the hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA exports and production initializer. BIOS/configuration preferences, mode selection, VRAM/aperture handling, mapping retries, framebuffer setup, and VRAM verification agree. The 15-reference vs 18-rebuilt direct _IOLog instruction count is explained by three reference error paths (at 0x05d9, 0x069f, 0x0955) pushing their name-getter arguments and IOLog arguments before tail-jumping to the shared call at 0x0a7a; the common add esp, 0x10 cleans all four arguments. Source and Hex-Rays each represent all 18 log expressions. This resolves the call-inventory difference as reference tail merging; other CFG/range/instruction-shape findings remain, so status stays control-flow-confirmed.
Current corrected 54-function IDA/BinRecon comparison marks this routine assembly-matched.

Reviewed the hash-bound v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode pair and production source. Both perform the same sequence: fetch displayInfo/parameters; skip when already linear or aperture enable fails; call depth and color-space helpers; select grey/gamma capability by depth; use pitch 0 for 1024-wide modes and 2 otherwise; request resolution 129; log a nonzero CRTC result; on success clear exactly vramBytes, set currentState=1, then reload the gamma table. The discarded color-space helper result and all BIOS arguments agree. CFG/range/instruction-shape differences remain binary findings, so status stays control-flow-confirmed rather than assembly-matched.

Reviewed the hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production source. Both call selectMode with AtiModeList/count/modeValidArray, store its result in modeNumber, log and return -1 for a negative selection, otherwise call isModeValid on the selection; zero validity returns 0, while a nonzero code is logged and returns -1. The incoming modeString is unused in reference, rebuild and source. The differing CFG is only the negative-selection block order; the call inventory and branch outcomes agree. Keep control-flow-confirmed because byte/CFG parity is not exact.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production source. Color-config inference uses the same queryData[19] priority (0x20, sign bit, 0x40, 0x10, fallback); the same four pixel-encoding strings are selected. For each mode, 24-bpp encoding is replaced; totalWidth, rowBytes, framebuffer, flags, unavailable reason and height*rowBytes memorySize are computed in the same order with equivalent conditions. Differences are loop/block layout and type/register choices; retain control-flow-confirmed because CFG and range parity remain open.

Reviewed the hash-bound v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production source. Both reject modeIndex >= AtiModeListCount with code 16; return 64 for 15-bpp modes without queryData[19] bit 1 or 24-bpp modes when colorConfig==5; otherwise compare height*rowBytes against memSizeToBytes(queryData[11]) and return 2 if too large, 0 when supported. Enum values and the unsigned upper-bound behavior agree. Compact OR branching in rebuilt code is equivalent to the reference/source short-circuit checks. Binary CFG/range findings remain; keep control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed the hash-bound v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production source. Both save 64 bytes from vram, write dwords 0..15, read them back in order, return 0 on the first mismatch, otherwise restore the saved 64 bytes and return 1. The reference also returns immediately on mismatch without restoring the test pattern; the reconstruction preserves that observable failure side effect. Binary CFG/range findings remain, so the entry stays control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production source. Both request BIOS aperture enable first and return failure on nonzero status. PCI devices then write address to config register 16, read it back, and fail on either BIOS-style error or address mismatch. Both refresh query data; only a successful query compares the 16-bit word at query offset 16 shifted left 20 against the requested address, returning 0 on match and 1 otherwise. Failure logs and ordering agree. Binary CFG/range findings remain, so status stays control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production source. Both fetch memory ranges and require exactly three (otherwise log and return -701), snapshot all three start/length pairs, replace only range 0 start, clear the list with num=0, then install three ranges. On install failure they restore the prior start using the same clear/install sequence; a restore failure is logged but does not replace the original return code. Missing range lists also log and return -701. Ordering, ownership of the range array, and errors agree. Binary CFG/range differences remain; retain control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed the v39 corrected IDA disassembly, Hex-Rays output, and ProgramDAC.m. Unsigned channel scaling and red/green/blue output order match the reference. v39 restores the reference's 82-byte function length and matches its red multiply/shift/output sequence; green and blue still differ in register allocation and instruction shape, and the delay-counter relocation differs. Those findings keep this entry control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA, ProgramDAC.m and DriverKit i386 ioPorts.h. Both disable the DAC control bits, reset the DAC index, and then either repeat each transfer-table entry 256/count times or program 256 gray entries for 8 bpp / 32*8 entries for 15- or 24-bpp. Other depths perform no table writes. Source outb expands to outb plus the locked delay-counter increment seen in the reference; mock port events intentionally record the port operation. Table values, loop bounds, brightness argument and return self agree. CFG/range/shape findings remain, so status stays control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode, production source, DriverKit display enum constants, and table byte layout. Both select shift 0/2 using ASIC, DAC, revision-C, supportsGrey256 and ramdacStyle; release the prior 3*count allocation; save count; allocate three contiguous byte channels; and derive displayInfo bits/color space. For 8-bit OneIsWhite, both use the low input byte and copy it to RGB. For RGB and 8/15/24 bpp, both extract input bytes 3/2/1 into red/green/blue after shifting. Unsupported formats free the allocation and null the red pointer, then both program the gamma table. Enum values confirm the source range check (3..4) matches the reference unsigned (depth-3)<=1 test. CFG/range/shape findings remain; keep control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode, production source and ATIBIOSRegisters offsets. Both return 1 when uninitialized, initialize BIOS function 5, form ECX flags from enabled and VGA aperture (bits 0 and 2), reject a nonzero address not aligned to 1 MiB with code 3, set bit 7 and EBX=address>>20 for a valid address, then invoke BIOS with dataSeg=0. Both map BIOS-call failure/nonzero AH to code 2 and otherwise return 0. Reference writes the low EBX word; after initBIOSBuf zeroes all 48 bytes, the source dword write has the same zero-extended value (address>>20 <= 0xfff). CFG/range/instruction differences remain; keep control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed v37 corrected IDA disassembly, Hex-Rays output, and ATI_BIOS.m. The EBX address field is read as a 16-bit value into a stack temporary, then zero-extended to the unsigned 32-bit output; this matches the reference low-word behavior for nonzero EBX high bits. The fixture supplies EBX 0xabcd5000 and expects 0x5000. Remaining CFG/range/shape findings reflect compiler lowering; status stays control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode, production source and ATIBIOSRegisters offsets. Both return 1 when uninitialized, zero the output buffer, initialize BIOS function 9, set CL=(query==0), and propagate createDataSegment failure. They set BX=0 and DX=0x88, invoke doBios with dataSeg=1, return 2 with a log on BIOS failure or nonzero AH, and return 0 otherwise. Reference stack locals map to the declared register fields (ECX low byte, EBX, EDX, EAX high byte); no register-offset mismatch found. CFG/range/instruction differences remain; retain control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed the hash-bound v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and production method. Both call setupCodeSegments, zero all 48 register-frame bytes, store the function byte at offset 4, set code/data selectors to 0x80/0x10, set BIOS entry offset to 100, place ATI_Bios_StackOffset >> 1 at EBP offset 28, and return that value. The typed ATIBIOSRegisters fields and source preserve the same offsets and widths. Calls agree; BinRecon still reports CFG, range-byte, alignment, and instruction-shape differences, so exact parity remains open.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and current source. Both save the original eight-byte descriptors at selectors 0x80, 0x90, and 0x98 into private offsets 0/8/24. They configure the BIOS ROM code descriptor at 0x80 (base=segmentBase, translated by VM_MAX_KERNEL_ADDRESS, limit=0xffff, access=0x9a), the _bios16 code descriptor at 0x90 (base=_bios16+KERNEL_LINEAR_BASE, limit=0xffff, access=0x9a, D/B set), and allocate/zero a 2048-byte stack at 0x98 (limit=0x7ff, access=0x92, with D/B cleared). Both set stack offset 2048 and selector 0x98. Descriptor bit updates preserve the same prior 0x30 flag bits and discard other granularity bits. Binary CFG/range/shape findings remain, so keep control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and current source. Both restore the saved eight-byte descriptors at selectors 0x80, 0x90, and 0x98 from private offsets 0/8/24, then free the stack allocation saved at private offset 32 with size 2048. The stack selector/offset globals are not restored in either implementation. Binary CFG/range/shape findings remain, so keep control-flow-confirmed.

Reviewed hash-bound actual-v36 reference/rebuilt IDA pseudocode and current source. Both reject size > 0x10000 with code 3, otherwise save the original 8-byte GDT descriptor at selector 0x88, set translated base from address-VM_MAX_KERNEL_ADDRESS, access byte 0x92, and encode size-1 into the descriptor limit. The granular branch uses the same rounded page-limit formula and nibble; the byte-granular branch uses the low 20 bits and high limit nibble. Size zero is accepted and follows unsigned underflow into the same 4 GiB granular encoding in both. Descriptor flag preservation and restoreDataSegment pairing agree. Remaining CFG/range/instruction-shape findings keep control-flow-confirmed.
